title: Dario Amodei says Anthropic held Mythos back for four months for safety
content:
Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei has defended the company’s “race to the top” strategy in a long post on X. He was replying to Nathan Calvin, chief strategy officer at the advocacy group Encode AI. Amodei listed nine decisions he said cost Anthropic commercially but made AI safer. He also said the company could have handled some of Calvin’s points better.
Calvin’s criticism followed Anthropic’s response to the backlash over its leaked AI safety bill. On 19 October, he wrote that the company’s answer was “still not really engaging with the heart” of the issue. Amodei posted his reply early on Wednesday. It has been viewed more than 800,000 times.
“Our strategy has always been what I’ve called the ‘race to the top’,” Amodei wrote. “By showing how it’s possible to build the technology responsibly, we can raise the bar for the entire industry.”
He said that strategy only works if the company practising it is at the frontier. He said he was “proud of our track record” and stood by it.
Thank you for this, @_NathanCalvin. I appreciate and am a fan of the investigative work you’ve done on behalf of AI safety and believe your comments are coming from a constructive, honest place.
Dario Amodei (@DarioAmodei) October 21, 2026
The nine decisions
Amodei said Anthropic first had its Mythos-class models in February. It did not make them generally available until June, when stronger cyber safeguards were in place. Until then, only a small group of partners working on cyber defence could use them. Earlier this month, Anthropic said China’s GLM-5.3 nearly matches Mythos at cyber exploits.
“We likely sacrificed a significant chunk of a several-month model lead,” Amodei wrote.
He said Anthropic’s biological safeguards are strict enough that biologists joke about them, and that rivals sometimes sell against the company on this point. He said Anthropic had seen and blocked possible attempts to use its models for bioweapons.
The list also included Anthropic’s role in California’s SB 53 safety law and his call in June for the government to have the power to block model releases. It included the company’s support for export controls on chips to China. Amodei said Anthropic was, as far as he knew, the only frontier company to restrict sales to companies controlled by the People’s Republic of China. He said distillation, training one model on another model’s answers, is no major commercial threat but raises security concerns.
The last item was the new public benefit fund, which will hold 5% of Anthropic’s shares, and possibly more over time.
What Amodei conceded
Amodei said Anthropic could have handled three of Calvin’s points better. He put them down to “rhetoric or policy communication that wasn’t carefully written”, in a company of more than 5,000 people.
“I am of course the CEO, and I take responsibility,” Amodei wrote.
He called Calvin’s point about changes to Anthropic’s Responsible Scaling Policy, its internal safety rulebook, “the most substantive item”. He said the old version was too rigid. On running a separate compliance framework next to that policy, he said he would “look into it further”.
Amodei also said Anthropic is nearing the point where AI moves too fast for safety work to keep up. That is shaping its thinking on “pacing”, he wrote, and he would “have more to say soon”.
The pushback
Sigal Samuel, who covers AI for Vox, asked Amodei on X for evidence that the strategy works.
“From the outside, it looks like Anthropic has done more on net to drive a race to the bottom,” Samuel wrote.

report.summary: Anthropic CEO 称 Mythos 模型为安全推迟四个月发布
report.background: Anthropic 因泄露的 AI 安全法案回应遭到批评，Encode AI 首席战略官 Nathan Calvin 指其未触及问题核心。10 月 21 日，CEO Dario Amodei 在 X 发长文回应，获得超 80 万次浏览。他辩护公司奉行的"向上竞争"（race to the top）策略——只有身处前沿，才能通过示范负责任地构建技术来抬高全行业标准，并列举九项自称牺牲商业利益换取安全的决策。这也是在开源模型快速逼近、监管压力上升的背景下，前沿实验室对"安全 vs 竞争"叙事的又一次公开表态。
key_points: Mythos 级模型 2 月就已具备，但直到 6 月网络防护措施到位才开放，此前仅供少数网络安全合作伙伴使用，Amodei 承认"牺牲了数月的模型领先优势"。
九项清单还包括：严格到被生物学家调侃的生物安全防护（已阻止疑似生物武器用途尝试）、支持加州 SB 53 法案、呼吁政府有权阻止模型发布、支持对华芯片出口管制。
Amodei 称 Anthropic 是唯一限制向中国控制企业销售的前沿公司；并认为蒸馏（用模型输出训练另一个模型）商业威胁不大，但带来安全隐患。
他承认三项批评有道理：Responsible Scaling Policy 修改沟通不当、缺少独立合规框架、部分措辞不严谨，称"作为 CEO 我承担责任"。
Amodei 罕见预警：AI 发展速度正接近安全研究跟不上的临界点，这将影响公司的"节奏控制"（pacing）思路，他"很快会有更多说明"。
Vox 记者 Sigal Samuel 公开质疑其证据："从外部看，Anthropic 净效果更像是推动了逐底竞争。"
report.impact: 对 AI 行业而言，这是一次关于"安全能否成为竞争优势"的公开辩论，若前沿公司真愿以商业利益换安全，可能抬高全行业合规基线；但质疑者认为这类叙事更像是公关护城河。对开发者，短期意味着更强的前沿模型访问门槛、更严的生物与网络安全审查；开源模型（如 GLM-5.3 在网络攻击能力上逼近 Mythos）会加速能力扩散。对普通用户，模型能力上线会更慢、限制更多，但滥用风险相应降低。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注：Anthropic 的 Responsible Scaling Policy 与 Model Card、其 Constitutional AI 与安全评估公开报告；对比阅读 OpenAI Preparedness Framework、Google DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework；政策侧可追踪加州 SB 53 文本与 Encode AI 的评论文章；能力对比可看 AI 安全评测机构（如 METR、UK AISI）发布的网络与生物风险基准。
